###
### Sabotage events can be random, they work on a pulse generated by the common JE 
### Sabotage should always considering if there is any revolutionary or unappeased IG and IG LEADER
### Assisting Nations are not necessarily working as saboteurs all the time.
### Matter of fact for now there is no longa manus behind the terror attack but in future I would like to implement it
### NEXT UPDATE SEND UPDATES TO ALL GREAT POWERS
### MAYBE MAKE THIS ROGUE FACTION A COMMON ENEMY
### 
### 

namespace = sabotage_event

sabotage_event.1 = {

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.1.t
    desc = sabotage_event.1.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.1.f

    event_image = {
        video = "unspecific_devastation"
    }

    cooldown = {
        days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
    }

    on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

    duration = 1

    trigger = {
        # Not already happened
        NOT = { has_variable = explosion_event_happened }

        # Not decentralized
        NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }

        # There EXISTS a revolutionary IG with a reckless/ambitious leader
        any_interest_group = {
            is_in_government = no
            leader = {
                OR = {
                    has_trait = reckless
                    has_trait = ambitious
                }
            }
            OR = {
                is_insurrectionary = yes
                ig_approval <= angry
            }
        }
    }

    immediate = {
        # MOVED TO EVENT 98
        # # Now grab the actual IG and leader for use in the event
        # random_interest_group = {
        #     limit = {
        #         is_in_government = no
        #         leader = {
        #             OR = {
        #                 has_trait = reckless
        #                 has_trait = ambitious
        #             }
        #         }
        #         OR = {
        #             is_insurrectionary = yes
        #             ig_approval <= angry
        #         }
        #     }
        #     save_scope_as = reckless_mf_ig
        #     leader = {
        #         save_scope_as = reckless_mf_leader
        #     }
        # }

        set_variable = {
            name = explosion_event_happened
            days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.1.a

        add_journal_entry = {
            type = hms_je_sabotage
        }
    }
}

sabotage_event.2 = { # Journal Speculates on the nature of the attack suggesting this is a government plot
                        #orchestrated by the state to seize more power

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.2.t
    desc = sabotage_event.2.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.2.f

    event_image = {
		video = "asia_union_leader"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

	duration = 1

	trigger = { has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage }

    cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

    option = { # Maybe they are right investigate further
        name = sabotage_event.2.a

        root = {

            add_modifier = {
                name = intelligence_low_effort_modifier
                days = 365
            }

            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.03
                strata = lower
            }

            random_list = {
                50 = {
                    custom_tooltip = {
                        text = police_sabotage_progress_tt
                        je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                            add_progress = { value = 2 name = sabotage_police_progress_bar }
                        }
                    }
                }
                50 = {
                    custom_tooltip = {
                        text = radicals_sabotage_progress_tt
                        je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                            add_progress = { value = 2 name = sabotage_radicals_progress_bar }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

        }
        
    }

    option = { # Pff this is nonsense
        name = sabotage_event.2.b

        root = {

            add_modifier = {
                name = opposed_criticism_modifier
            }

            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.07
                strata = lower
            }

            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.04
                strata = middle
            }

        }

    }


}

sabotage_event.4 = { # One of our commanders framed by the radical journals 
                      # has been shot dead in public 

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.4.t
    desc = sabotage_event.4.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.4.f

    cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

    event_image = {
        video = "southamerica_public_figure_assassination"
    }

    on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

    duration = 1

    trigger = {
        AND = {
            any_scope_character = {
                has_role = general
                is_busy = no
                is_ruler = no
                is_immortal = no
            }
            has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
        }
    }

    immediate = {
        random_scope_character = {
			limit = {
				has_role = general
				is_busy = no
				is_ruler = no
				is_immortal = no
			}
			save_scope_as = killed_commander
		}
        
        
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.4.a # This chaos must be stopped
        default_option = yes

        
        scope:killed_commander = {
            interest_group = {
                add_modifier = {
                    name = retired_commander_interest_group_impact
                    days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
                }
            }
        }

        scope:killed_commander = {
            kill_character = yes
        }
           
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.4.b # fabricate some evidence against him to frame him and calm the public

        scope:killed_commander = {
            interest_group = {
                add_modifier = {
                   name = retired_commander_interest_group_impact
                   days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
                }
            }
        }

        scope:killed_commander = {
            kill_character = yes
        }

        root = {
            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.03
                pop_type = officers
            }
    
            add_radicals = {
                value = -0.02
                strata = lower
            }
    
            add_radicals = {
                value = -0.01
                strata = middle
            }
        }
    }
}


# Journal trying to frame our commander ### this can lead to a random general getting clapped
sabotage_event.66 = {

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.66.t
    desc = sabotage_event.66.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.66.f

    cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

    event_image = {
        video = "southamerica_election"
    }

    on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_newspaper.dds"

    duration = 1

    trigger = {
        AND = {
            any_scope_character = {
                has_role = general
                is_busy = no
                is_ruler = no
                is_immortal = no
            }
            has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
        }
    }

    immediate = {
        
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.66.a # This is pure sensationalism

        every_scope_general = {
            limit = {
                is_busy = no
                is_ruler = no
                is_immortal = no
            }
            add_modifier = {
                name = framed_for_sabotage_modifier
                days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
            }
        }

        add_radicals = {
            value = 0.03
            strata = lower
        }

        add_radicals = {
            value = 0.02
            strata = middle
        }
        
        custom_tooltip = {
            text = commander_in_danger_tt_low_chance
            random_list = {
                65 = {}
                35 = {
                    root = {
                        trigger_event = { id = sabotage_event.4 popup = yes days = 7}
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.66.b # What if the journals are right ??

        every_scope_general = {
            limit = {
                is_busy = no
                is_ruler = no
                is_immortal = no
            }
            add_modifier = {
                name = framed_for_sabotage_modifier
                days = stupidly_long_modifier_time
            }
        }

        custom_tooltip = {
            text = commander_in_danger_tt_high_chance
            random_list = {
                20 = {}
                80 = {
                    root = {
                        trigger_event = { id = sabotage_event.4 popup = yes days = 7}
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        root = {
            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.03
                pop_type = officers
            }
    
            add_radicals = {
                value = -0.03
                strata = lower
            }
    
            add_radicals = {
                value = -0.01
                strata = middle
            }
        }

        custom_tooltip = {
            text = half_chance_sabotage_progress_tt # This still says split chance altough is not 50/50
            random_list = {
                25 = {
                    je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                        add_progress = { value = 3 name = sabotage_radicals_progress_bar }
                    }
                }
                75 = {
                    je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                        add_progress = { value = 3 name = sabotage_police_progress_bar }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
  
}

sabotage_event.5 = {
    type = country_event
    title = sabotage_event.5.t
    desc = sabotage_event.5.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.5.f

    cooldown = { days = never_fire_again_modifier_time }

    event_image = {
		video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

	duration = 1

	trigger = {
        has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
	}

    immediate = {
        # Pick first friendly helper
        random_country = {
			limit = {
                country_rank >= rank_value:minor_power
                NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
                NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
                has_strategic_adjacency = root
                relations:root >= relations_threshold:cold
			}
			save_scope_as = helper_country_1
		}

        # Pick second friendly helper, excluding the first
        random_country = {
			limit = {
                
                NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
                NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
                NOT = { THIS = scope:helper_country_1}
                has_strategic_adjacency = root
                relations:root >= relations_threshold:cold
			}
			save_scope_as = helper_country_2
		}
    }

   

    option = { # Accept help from first country
        name = sabotage_event.5.a

        trigger = {
            exists = scope:helper_country_1
        }

        root = {
            change_relations = {
                country = scope:helper_country_1
                value = 25
            }

            set_variable = {
                name = accepted_foreign_assistance
                months = 12
            }
        }

        if = {
            limit = {
                has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
            }
            je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                add_progress = { value = 2 name = sabotage_police_progress_bar }
            }
        }

        
    }

    option = { # Accept help from second country
        name = sabotage_event.5.b

        trigger = {
            exists = scope:helper_country_2
        }

        root = {
            change_relations = {
                country = scope:helper_country_2
                value = 25
            }

            set_variable = {
                name = accepted_foreign_assistance
                months = 12
            }
        }

        if = {
            limit = {
                has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
            }
            je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                add_progress = { value = 2 name = sabotage_police_progress_bar }
            }
        }

        
    }

    option = { # Decline all assistance
        name = sabotage_event.5.c

        root = {
            add_modifier = {
                name = sabotage_declined_foreign_assistance
                days = 365
            }

            set_variable = {
                name = refused_foreign_assistance
                months = 12
            }
        }

        if = {
            limit = {
                has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage
            }
            je:hms_je_sabotage ?= {
                add_progress = { value = 2 name = sabotage_radicals_progress_bar }
            }
        }

        
    }
}

sabotage_event.98 = { # Found the perpetrators

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.98.t
    desc = sabotage_event.98.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.98.f

    event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_raiding.dds"

	duration = 1

	trigger = {

    }

    immediate = {

        random_interest_group = {
            limit = {
                is_in_government = no
                leader = {
                    OR = {
                        has_trait = reckless
                        has_trait = ambitious
                    }
                }
                OR = {
                    is_insurrectionary = yes
                    ig_approval <= angry
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = reckless_mf_ig
            leader = {
                save_scope_as = reckless_mf_leader
            }
        }

    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.98.a

        scope:reckless_mf_leader = {
            kill_character = yes
        }

        scope:reckless_mf_ig = {
            add_radicals = {
                value = 0.03
            }
        }

        add_modifier = {
            name = perpetrators_caught_modifier
            years = 10
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.98.b

        add_modifier = {
            name = perpetrators_caught_modifier
            years = 10
        }
    }

}


sabotage_event.99 = { # Terrorist group escapes the national boundaries

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.99.t
    desc = sabotage_event.99.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.99.f

    event_image = {
        video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
    }

    immediate = {
        random_country = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_diplomatic_pact = {
                        who = ROOT
                        type = rivalry
                    }
                    relations:root <= relations_threshold:cold
                }
                NOT = { THIS = ROOT }
                NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized }
            }
            save_scope_as = rival_country_1
        }

        root = {
            set_variable =  {
                name = country_sabotaged
            }
        }
    }

    on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

    icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"

    duration = 1

    trigger = { 
        # has_journal_entry = hms_je_sabotage 
        # exists = scope:rival_country_1
    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.99.a # Publicly demand their extradition

        default_option = yes

        #MUST BE for when when dont have office of foreign affairs
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_office_of_foreign_affairs }
        }

        scope:rival_country_1 = {
            trigger_event = { id = hms_sabotage_event.100 }
        }

        root = {
            change_relations = {
                country = scope:rival_country_1
                value = -25
            }

            add_modifier = {
                name = perpetrators_escaped_justice_modifier
                years = 10
            }
        }

        # TODO IN THE FUTURE
        # This gives war goal to our country against the rival country
        # set_variable =  { 
        #     name = flagged_country_as_home_of_terrorists
        #     value = scope:rival_country_1
        # }

    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.99.b # If only we had foreign affairs to take care of this...

        # HINT THAT THIS COULD BE DIFFERENT HAD WE ENACTED OFA
        trigger = {
            NOT = { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_office_of_foreign_affairs }
        }

        add_modifier = {
            name = perpetrators_escaped_justice_modifier
            years = 10
        }

    }

    option = {
        name = sabotage_event.99.c # Dispatch a delegation to negotiate extradition ...

        # WE HAVE OFA WE CAN USE IT 
        trigger = {
           has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_office_of_foreign_affairs 
        }

        scope:country = {
            set_variable = sent_delegation_for_terrorist_extradition
        }

        scope:rival_country_1 = {
            trigger_event = {
                id = sabotage_event.100
                days = 7
            }
        }

    }

}

sabotage_event.100 = { # RIVAL COUNTRY RECEIVES NEWS THAT A DELEGATION HAS ARRIVED TO TAKE THE ESCAPED RADICALS TO JAIL

    type = country_event
    placement = root

    title = sabotage_event.100.t
    desc = sabotage_event.100.d
    flavor = sabotage_event.100.f

    event_image = {
        video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting"
    }

    duration = 1

    immediate = {

        random_country = {
            limit = {
                    has_variable = country_sabotaged
            }
            save_scope_as = delegation_sender_country
            remove_variable = country_sabotaged
        }

        root = {
            set_variable = country_where_radicals_seek_refuge # Connects to the 2 possible outcome events to send back to the country originally sending the delegation
        }

    }

    option = { # ACCEPT TO EXTRADATE
        name = sabotage_event.100.a

        add_modifier = {
            name = accepted_to_extradate_radicals
            years = 15
        }

        change_relations = {
            country = scope:delegation_sender_country
            value = 25
        }

        scope:delegation_sender_country = {
            trigger_event = {
                id = sabotage_event.102 # MUITO BUENO
            }
        }

        ai_chance = {
            base = 10
        
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:delegation_sender_country = {
                        relations:root <= -25
                    }
                }
                multiply = 5
            }
        }

    }

    option = { # REFUSE TO EXTRADATE
        name = sabotage_event.100.b

        add_modifier = {
            name = refused_to_extradate_radicals
            years = 15
        }

        add_radicals = {
            value = 0.05
            strata = lower
        }

        scope:delegation_sender_country = {
            change_relations = {
                country = root
                value = -20
            }

            trigger_event = {
                id = sabotage_event.101 # OI EFE NO BUENO 
            }
        }

        ai_chance = {
            base = 10
        
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:delegation_sender_country = {
                        relations:root <= -25
                    }
                }
                multiply = 5
            }
        }
    }

}
